name: Burgess Park Playgrounds
description: Colourful play and climbing equipment for children up to 14, with separate play areas for under-5s and over-5s, and water play jets at Chumleigh Gardens in summer. Toilets are at Chumleigh Gardens and at the tennis pavilion café near Addington Square.
